title: On Ceasing all talk of the matter
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：cease　|　正文 355 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cease 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the clerk ① ceased all talk of the matter for the whole place, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② ceases all talk of the matter without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ cease all talk of the matter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ ceased all talk of the matter before — a line in the file for May 1971 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Ceasing all talk of the matter for the whole place, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ cease to answer letters altogether without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Cease to answer letters altogether at once and never mention it again.

By 1984 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ ceases to answer letters altogether for the whole place every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ ceased all talk of the matter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To cease all talk of the matter, my mother said in 1989, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody ceases all talk of the matter without a word of thanks again and somebody must cease all talk of the matter for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 停止（一般过去式 ceased all talk of the matter：1977 年书记员头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 停止（一般现在 ceases all talk of the matter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 停止（不定式 to cease all talk of the matter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 停止（过去完成时 had ceased all talk of the matter：1971 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 停止（动名词 ceasing all talk of the matter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 中断（cease to answer letters altogether：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去中断索性连信也不回）
G. v. 中断（cease to answer letters altogether：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 停止（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 ceases to answer letters altogether，而母亲又一次 ceased all talk of the matter）

answers.why: cease 意为“停止”，1977 年书记员替所有人停止不再提起那件事，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 ceased。
cease 意为“停止”，自那以后书记员不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 ceases。
cease 意为“停止”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯停止不再提起那件事”，此处为不定式 to cease all talk of the matter。
cease 意为“停止”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 1984 年之前就有人停止过，故用过去完成时 had ceased。
cease 意为“停止”，书记员说“停止不再提起那件事这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 ceasing all talk of the matter 作主语。
cease 意为“中断”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去中断索性连信也不回”，should ever 之后用原形 cease to answer letters altogether。
cease 意为“中断”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻中断索性连信也不回（cease to answer letters altogether at once），以后再也不要提起。
cease 意为“停止”，新来的申请人每个月份都照例中断索性连信也不回，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 ceases。
cease 意为“停止”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人停止不再提起那件事，用一般过去式 ceased 叙述。
cease 意为“停止”，结尾那句是母亲 1989 年的话：要停止不再提起那件事，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cease 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the clerk ceased all talk of the matter for the whole place, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk ceases all talk of the matter without a word of thanks whenever the office asks.
Ceasing all talk of the matter for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever cease to answer letters altogether without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office ceases to answer letters altogether for the whole place every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother ceased all talk of the matter again, and the office remembered that half.
